percentage points (95% margin of error, from the published design effect)
CauseWay computation from World Bank published values and design effect

Point estimate 11.9%; 95% confidence interval 9.1% to 14.7%; base 1,000 interviews (the whole sample); design effect 1.9, the value the World Bank publishes for Yemen's survey (The Global Findex Database 2021, Appendix A, Table A.1, printed p.17). CauseWay computation (close-out CR-02, 10 October 2026): margin = 1.96 x sqrt(1.9) x sqrt(p(1-p)/1,000), the World Bank's own margin-of-error formula (Table A.1, footnote c), applied to the World Bank's published unrounded value p (11.9033656433415). No respondent-level data are used. This replaces the earlier derivation from the respondent file (FC-1), withdrawn under brief v5. Previous record: Point estimate 11.9%; 95% confidence interval 9.7% to 14.1%; base 1000 respondents; design effect 1.16. CauseWay derivation: Hajek ratio estimator with Taylor-linearization variance on the published survey weight (wgt) only. The public-use file carries no PSU or stratum identifier, so clustering is not captured and the true interval may be wider, never narrower. A simple binomial standard error is not used. The respondent file is held under the World Bank Microdata Research License and is never redistributed, committed to this repository or published.
